title: NLO – DMS Feeder Interlock Classifier Status

fields.latestPosition: New draft form 18/09 – not yet in register.
fields.nextAction: Add to register; assign priority and approver
fields.why:
DMS Feeders can be started with the classifier dart plugs in manual and 0%
This has led to classifier overfilling events and has potential to bog classifiers.
fields.design:
Addition of a process interlock that prevents feed being introduced to the DMS classifiers whilst the dart plug is close to the following assets:
- 160-FE-0481: 160-LIC-0470 Classifier Controller in Manual >5% or Auto
- 160-FE-0497: 160-LIC-0472 Classifier Controller in Manual >5% or Auto
fields.impact: DMS feeders will not start unless the classifier level controller is in Auto or Manual above 5%.
